rl-es-def.back: The ground an animal runs to when threatened.

rl-es-mule.front: Where does a mule deer run from a coyote?
rl-es-mule.back: To and up slopes into rough broken ground, often stotting (Lingle 2002).

rl-es-wt.front: Where does a white tail run?
rl-es-wt.back: Down and away, fast, into thick cover.

rl-es-goat.back: Steep slopes usually 40 degrees or more of sheer or broken cliffs.

rl-es-quail.back: They run to thorny brush within 15 to 30 m, then flush.
